audit.why: 4/10 difficulty with Renekton owning levels 1-5 fits 50.76% over 2687 games in a lane he must close early; Vayne owns 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text invented 'Phantom Step (her R's Tumble invis)'.
audit.why: Vayne's R is Final Hour; Riot's text grants 'Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown'. No ability named Phantom Step exists.
audit.corrected: Name Final Hour and use its real 100/85/70s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was described as a flat 'wall-stun' with no statement of the condition, and report[5].t read as filler.
audit.why: Riot's text: Condemn knocks the target back and only impales/stuns if they collide with terrain. Fighting off walls removes the stun entirely. Cooldown 20/18/16/14/12, 90 mana, and it is a projectile.
audit.corrected: Condemn knocks you back and only stuns if you hit terrain — fight in open ground.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing flagged Tumble as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Tumble carries the autoReset flag and drops to a 2s cooldown at rank 5 — the attack wind-up, not the cast, is the tell for her burst.

edits.before: Sundered Sky or Stride Breaker keeps you sticky enough to catch a Vayne who has not yet built Phantom Step (her R's Tumble invis) — force before Galeforce or Kraken Slayer hit.
edits.after: Sundered Sky or Stride Breaker keeps you sticky enough to catch a Vayne without Final Hour up — that ult is what makes her Tumble invisible, and it is a 100-second cooldown at rank 1.

edits.before: Past two items this is Vayne's lane. Kraken Slayer true damage on top of Silver Bolts means she shreds your health bar before you can close the gap, and Galeforce or Phantom Step lets her reposition through your E-in every time. Do not fight her alone in the side lane at this stage — rotate, group for objectives, and let your team absorb the Condemn while you dive from another angle. Your carry threat at 50 minutes is substantially lower than hers; cash the early lead into towers and dragon control rather than a second solo kill that probably will not come.
edits.after: Past two items this is Vayne's lane. Kraken Slayer true damage on top of Silver Bolts means she shreds your health bar before you can close the gap, and Galeforce or Final Hour's invisible Tumble lets her reposition through your E-in every time. Do not fight her alone in the side lane at this stage — rotate, group for objectives, and let your team absorb the Condemn while you dive from another angle. Your carry threat at 50 minutes is substantially lower than hers; cash the early lead into towers and dragon control rather than a second solo kill that probably will not come.

edits.before: You remain dangerous but Vayne starts kiting more intelligently with Tumble; trade only when you have 50 Fury banked and Condemn is visibly on cooldown.
edits.after: Vayne kites with Tumble — it is a 2s cooldown at rank 5 and resets her auto, so the wind-up is the tell; trade only with 50 Fury and Condemn down.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — W-stun + Q her.
edits.after: Condemn knocks you back and only stuns if you hit terrain — fight in open ground, off walls.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Condemn is down 20s at rank 1 — bait or dodge it before you slice in.

notes: Level chart agrees across full, content and packet — no chart edits. 'Phantom Step' was a fabricated ability name (calibration-class error) and is now killed in both places it appeared. Vayne's Silver Bolts is genuinely percent-max-HP true damage per Riot's own text, so those lines stand.
